## ClientQuestion

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

Client-facing question payload — deliberately omits the answer.

```ts
export interface ClientQuestion {
    id: string;
    kind: QuestionKind;
    question: string;
    context?: string;
    mode: QuestionMode;
    options: QuizOption[];
}
```
